_comment: AI staff. Candidates refresh every Monday; each has 1–10 in every skill (skills.json ids) and a weekly wage that follows their best skills. Roles decide what they do; anyone can do any job, the right person in the right role is quick. Staff act through the same host commands as players (as virtual peers), so every rule, part and timer applies to them too. Pay = base + their best skills^1.75 (so a level-9 specialist costs several times a level-3 starter); it's reviewed every Friday as they level up by doing the work.

morale._comment: Morale 0-100 per member of staff (StaffMorale). Speed scales from speed_range[0] at 0 to speed_range[1] at 100 (×1.0 at 50); the pause between jobs is multiplied by idle_mult_range the same way. Drops: going too long without a tea break, a week of high utilisation, pay that lags their skill (they ask for a rise), late/cancelled orders, overtime. Rises: tea breaks (more if someone else made it), pay rises, a thank-you (once a day), good shift ratings, coming back from a course. Below notice_threshold at close for warn_days in a row = a warning email; for notice_days = they hand in their notice and leave after notice_period_days unless morale is back above stay_threshold.

roles.name: All-rounder
roles.desc: Does whatever's most urgent: ships, packs, tests, repairs, grades, hauls.

roles.name: Hauler
roles.desc: Brings kit in off pallets, shelves it, unboxes parcels, takes parcels to OUTGOING.

roles.name: Test technician
roles.desc: Runs the test benches: loads units, swaps USBs between diagnostics and imaging, clears finished units.

roles.name: Repair technician
roles.desc: Works the repair bench within their repair level, using parts from the bins (orders missing parts).

roles.name: Grader & lister
roles.desc: Grades imaged units at the grading desk, prices them at the guide and lists them on Flogit.

roles.name: Packer
roles.desc: Packs sold orders at the packing table and puts parcels on the OUTGOING shelf.

roles.name: Buyer (office)
roles.desc: Sits at the office PC and buys good-value lots when the pipeline runs low, within a budget.

roles.name: Salesperson (office)
roles.desc: Works the phones and listings: more Flogit buyers while they're in.
